meta.title: Publishing Articles and Categories
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Publishing Articles and Categories".

steps.title: Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected
steps.text: Forecasters expect heavy rain across the region this weekend.

steps.title: Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement
steps.text: The trade summit closed with a new agreement between the participating countries.

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Publishing Articles and Categories', 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories', '

An article shows on your site only when both the article and its category are published. In this tour you see that for yourself.

The category World News and two featured articles are ready: Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected in Uncategorised and Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement in World News. Look at your site first: click Site in the toolbar of the Joomla Playground. Both articles are on the home page.

This tour follows the tutorial 7.1 Publishing Articles and Categories of the Joomla User Guide.

', 1, '["com_cpanel","com_content","com_categories"]', 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', 'Joomla User Guide: 7.1 Publishing Articles and Categories', 1, 1); INSERT INTO `#__guidedtour_steps` (`tour_id`, `title`, `description`, `ordering`, `position`, `target`, `type`, `interactive_type`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `params`) VALUES ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Content', '

In the menu on the left, click Content.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

', 1, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu li.item-level-1:has(a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]) > a.has-arrow', 2, 4, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 2, 'right', 'body.com_cpanel #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Open the article', '

Click Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected to edit it.

', 3, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" weekend-storm-watch-heavy-rain-expected"]) a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Unpublish the article', '

Set Status to Unpublished.

', 4, 'left', '.view-article #jform_state', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"0"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 5, 'bottom', '.view-article #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'The status icons', '

Look at your site and reload the home page: Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected is gone. An article must be published to show on the site.

Back here, the Status of Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected is a grey cross (unpublished); the other article has a green tick (published). Hover over an icon to read what it means.

', 6, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" weekend-storm-watch-heavy-rain-expected"]) .article-status', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Publish it again', '

You can also publish or unpublish an article right here in the list: click the grey cross of Weekend Storm Watch: Heavy Rain Expected.

On your site, both articles are back on the home page.

', 7, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" weekend-storm-watch-heavy-rain-expected"]) .article-status [data-item-task="articles.publish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Content › Categories', '

Click Categories in Content.

', 8, 'right', 'body.com_content.view-articles #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Unpublish the category', '

Categories have the same status icons. Hover over one to read what it means.

Click the green tick of World News to unpublish it.

', 9, 'right', '#categoryList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"]) [data-item-task="categories.unpublish"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Content › Articles', '

Click Articles in Content.

', 10, 'right', 'body.com_categories.view-categories #sidebarmenu a[href="index.php?option=com_content&view=articles"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'An unpublished category', '

Look at your site and reload the home page: Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement is gone, although the article itself is still published. An article and its category must both be published.

Here, its Status icon is now a grey dash; hover over it. Below the title, the category shows (Unpublished).

', 11, 'bottom', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" trade-summit-ends-in-new-agreement"])', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Open the article', '

Click Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement to edit it.

', 12, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" trade-summit-ends-in-new-agreement"]) a[href*="task=article.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'The category in brackets', '

The Category field shows World News in brackets: the category is unpublished.

', 13, 'left', '.view-article .control-group:has(#jform_catid)', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Close without saving', '

Click Close.

', 14, 'bottom', '.view-article .button-cancel', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Open the category', '

Below the title of Trade Summit Ends in New Agreement, click its category World News to edit the category.

', 15, 'right', '#articleList tr:has([title$=" trade-summit-ends-in-new-agreement"]) a[href*="task=category.edit"]', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=articles', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Publish the category', '

Set Status to Published.

', 16, 'left', '.view-category #jform_published', 2, 6, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', '{"required":1,"requiredvalue":"1"}'), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Save the category', '

Click Save & Close.

', 17, 'bottom', '.view-category #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=category&layout=edit&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-publishing-articles-and-categories'), 'Well done!', '

World News is published again.

Look at your site and reload the home page: both articles are back.

Take care when you unpublish a category: all its articles disappear from the site with it.

', 18, 'bottom', '#categoryList tr:has(a[title$=" World News"])', 0, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_categories&view=categories&extension=com_content', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL);
